notes: Owner report 2026-10-23 (screenshot): a newly hired Mortgage Ops agent signing in at /mortgage-ops/login sees 'This staging Cognito account is not currently eligible for passwordless email OTP.' Root cause in tenant-admin.mjs runHireMortgageAgent: the hire creates the Cognito login with a suppressed temporary password (AdminCreateUser) and never makes a password permanent, so the login stays in FORCE_CHANGE_PASSWORD, where Cognito offers no EMAIL_OTP sign-in. Tenant invites were fixed for the same cause on 2026-10-18 (confirmInvitedLogin, a1a8971ed); the hire never was. The fix: handleHireMortgageAgent confirms a login the hire created, only after the hire commits (the same confirmInvitedLogin), and re-hiring an existing agent repairs that agent's login only when it is still FORCE_CHANGE_PASSWORD and linked to the same agent (identity_accounts), then sends the invite again; any other login is never touched. Expected live e111223d is main's bytes: read-only production inspect run 40008878953 (main 366c9543f) found the live member ALREADY_ACCEPTED at e111223d; the guarded REPLACE refuses if the live member differs. No SQL change.
